verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a developer-facing bank like Column, but nothing in the evidence documents program-level limits, approval stages, or a process for raising limits. The closest items are adjacent controls: per-account-number ACH permissions and limits the customer configures (column-comm-7), plus overdraft and hold features. These are not documentation of the bank's own program limits or the path to raise them.

support.subject: As a founder, growth doesn't hit invisible walls — program-level limits, approval stages, and the path to raising them are documented rather than discovered in an email from the bank
